name: Kimi Iro Promenade ~Please Take Me Prom Party~
original_name: 君色プロムナード ～please take me prom party～
source:
”Our heroine is an average 3rd year student, spending her life leisurely while graduation approaches thanks to the schools escalator system reaching till university.

One sentence from her best friend changes that.

[...So, did you decide on who are you going to prom with?]

Suddenly, life turns a lot more hectic and busy when she only has the time-limit of 3 months to find a partner to go to the promenade with…

[taken from [url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/08/12/otome-game-review-kimiiro-promenade-by-honeycomb/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
translation:
女主人公是一名普通的高三学生。由于学校实行一路直升大学的制度，临近毕业的她依然过着悠闲自在的日子。

好友的一句话改变了这一切。

“所以，你决定和谁一起参加毕业舞会了吗？”

她突然忙得不可开交：距离舞会只剩3个月，她必须在期限到来前找到一名舞伴……

[译自 [url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/08/12/otome-game-review-kimiiro-promenade-by-honeycomb/]Koorin的博客[/url]]
